steps: Take a free online course on accounting fundamentals (e.g., Coursera 'Introduction to Financial Accounting')
Learn basic AI and automation concepts relevant to finance (e.g., edX 'AI for Finance')
Study economics principles through a short course (e.g., Khan Academy Microeconomics)
Practice financial reporting by analyzing real company statements (e.g., SEC filings)
Develop attention to detail by reconciling sample bank statements (use templates)
